arxiv-1605-00724.title: An Effective Limited Feedback Scheme for FD-MIMO Based on Noncoherent Detection and Kronecker Product Codebook
arxiv-1605-00724.creator: Lisi Jiang, Juling Zeng
arxiv-1605-00724.description: Abstract The low complexity quantization of channel state information (CSI) and the utilization of vertical freedom of three dimension (3D) channels are two critical issues in the limited feedback design of the full dimension multi-input-multi-output (FD-MIMO) systems. In this paper, we propose an effective limited feedback scheme.

arxiv-2209-01803.title: Detecting unanticipated mutual recursion using Elegant Objects representation of object-oriented programs
arxiv-2209-01803.creator: Nikolai Kudasov Mikhail Olokin Oleksii Potyomkin, Nikolay Shilov Maxim Stepanov
arxiv-2209-01803.description: Abstract Elegant Objects (EO) is a variation of the object-oriented programming paradigm that favors pure objects and decoration. EO programming language is based on these ideas and has been suggested by Bugayenko as an intermediate representation for object-oriented programs. This paper provides plausible representations in EO of some class-based constructions from Java, C++, and Python.

arxiv-2302-08561.title: TOPOLOGICAL SIGNAL PROCESSING OVER WEIGHTED SIMPLICIAL COMPLEXES
arxiv-2302-08561.creator: Claudio Battiloro, Stefania Sardellitti, Sergio Barbarossa, Paolo Di Lorenzo
arxiv-2302-08561.description: Abstract Weighing the topological domain over which data can be represented and analysed is a key strategy in many signal processing and machine learning applications, enabling the extraction and exploitation of meaningful data features and their (higher order) relationships. Our goal in this paper is to present topological signal processing tools for weighted simplicial complexes.

arxiv-2311-14663.title: Lattice investigations of the chimera baryon spectrum in the S ​ p ​ ( 4 ) Sp(4) gauge theory
arxiv-2311-14663.creator: Ed Bennett, Deog Ki Hong, Ho Hsiao, Jong-Wan Lee, C.-J. David Lin, Biagio Lucini, Maurizio Piai, Davide Vadacchino
arxiv-2311-14663.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ed Bennett, Deog Ki Hong, Ho Hsiao, Jong-Wan Lee, C.-J. David Lin, Biagio Lucini, Maurizio Piai, Davide Vadacchino. We report the results of lattice numerical studies of the S ​ p ​ ( 4 ) Sp(4) gauge theory coupled to fermions (hyperquarks) transforming in the fundamental and two-index antisymmetric representations of the gauge group. This strongly-coupled theory is the minimal candidate for the ultraviolet completion of composite Higgs models that facilitate the mechanism of partial compositeness for generating the top-quark mass.

arxiv-2403-19121.title: Code Comparison Tuning for Code Large Language Models
arxiv-2403-19121.creator: Yufan Jiang, Qiaozhi He, Xiaomin Zhuang, Zhihua Wu
arxiv-2403-19121.description: Abstract We present Code Comparison Tuning (CCT), a simple and effective tuning method for code large language models (Code LLMs) to better handle subtle code errors. Specifically, we integrate the concept of comparison into instruction tuning, both at the token and sequence levels, enabling the model to discern even the slightest deviations in code.

arxiv-2405-11398.title: Second-harmonic optical diffraction tomography
arxiv-2405-11398.creator: Amirhossein Saba, Carlo Gigli, Ye Pu, Demetri Psaltis
arxiv-2405-11398.description: Abstract Optical diffraction tomography (ODT) has emerged as an important label-free tool in biomedicine to measure the three-dimensional (3D) structure of a biological sample. In this paper, we describe ODT using second-harmonic generation (SHG) which is a coherent nonlinear optical process with a strict symmetry selectivity and has several advantages over traditional fluorescence methods.

arxiv-2405-19242.title: Modeling public opinion control by a charismatic leader
arxiv-2405-19242.creator: Tiago S. A. N. Simões, Antonio Coniglio, Hans J. Herrmann, Lucilla de Arcangelis
arxiv-2405-19242.description: Abstract We study the average long-time behavior of the binary opinions of a social group with peer-to-peer interactions under the influence of an external bias and a persuadable leader, a strongly-biased agent with a dynamic opinion with the intention of spreading it across the system.

arxiv-2409-14410.title: Decay properties of light 1 − ⁣ + 1^{-+} hybrids
arxiv-2409-14410.creator: Juzheng Liang, Siyang Chen, Ying Chen, Chunjiang Shi, Wei Sun
arxiv-2409-14410.description: Abstract We explore the decay properties of the isovector and isoscalar 1 − ⁣ + 1^{-+} light hybrids, π 1 \pi_{1} and η 1 \eta_{1} , in N f = 2 N_{f}=2 lattice QCD at a pion mass m π ≈ 417 ​ MeV m_{\pi}\approx 417~\mathrm{MeV} .

arxiv-2411-08531.title: Classification and Morphological Analysis of DLBCL Subtypes in H&E-Stained Slides
arxiv-2411-08531.creator: Ravi Kant Gupta ⋆ \star Mohit Jindal ⋆ \star Garima Jain † \dagger Epari Sridhar ⋄ \diamond Subhash Yadav ⋄ \diamond
arxiv-2411-08531.description: Abstract We address the challenge of automated classification of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) into its two primary subtypes: activated B-cell-like (ABC) and germinal center B-cell-like (GCB). Accurate classification between these subtypes is essential for determining the appropriate therapeutic strategy, given their distinct molecular profiles and treatment responses.

arxiv-2501-19405.title: Human-Precision Medicine Interaction: Public Perceptions of Polygenic Risk Score for Genetic Health Prediction
arxiv-2501-19405.creator: Yuhao Sun, Albert Tenesa, John Vines
arxiv-2501-19405.description: Abstract . Precision Medicine (PM) transforms the traditional “one-drug-fits-all” paradigm by customising treatments based on individual characteristics, and is an emerging topic for HCI research on digital health. A key element of PM, the Polygenic Risk Score (PRS), uses genetic data to predict an individual’s disease risk.

arxiv-2511-15257.title: M, Toolchain and Language for Reusable Model Compilation
arxiv-2511-15257.creator: Hiep Hong Trinh, Federico Ciccozzi, Abu Naser Masud, Marjan Sirjani, Mikael Sjödin
arxiv-2511-15257.description: Abstract Complex software-driven systems—such as cyber-physical systems (CPS), Internet of Things (IoT) platforms, multi-agent systems (MAS), and autonomous robotics—often combine distributed concurrent computation with continuous interaction with the physical environment. Engineering them benefits from actionable software models systematically transformed into specialized artifacts for simulation, verification, or execution, often requiring distinct formalisms, specification languages, or platforms.

pmc-12461578.title: Tree-based scan statistics to generate drug repurposing hypotheses: a test case using sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors
pmc-12461578.creator: George S Q Tan, Judith C Maro, Shirley V Wang, Sengwee Toh, Jedidiah I Morton, Jenni Ilomäki, Jenna Wong, Xiaojuan Li
pmc-12461578.description: Most drug repurposing studies using real-world data focused on validating, instead of generating, hypotheses. We used tree-based scan statistics to generate repurposing hypotheses for sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i). We used an active-comparator, new-user study design to create a 1:1 propensity-score matched cohort of SGLT2i and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP4i) initiators in the Merative MarketScan Research Databases.

pmc-13042208.title: Hydrogen Bonding Network in Interlayer Spaces of a Partially Deuterated Layered α‐Sn (IV) Phosphate: A Solid‐State MAS NMR Study
pmc-13042208.creator: Vladimir I Bakhmutov, Hong‐Cai Zhou
pmc-13042208.description: Samples of a layered α‐Sn (IV) phosphate were partially deuterated by soaking with D2O to yield a mixture of two isotopomers Sn (HPO4) (DPO4).c‐H2O and Sn (DPO4)2.c‐H2O containing cavity water c‐H2O.
